FECT.Settings.ShowDispHint: Colors portrait borders based on token disposition (friendly, neutral, hostile, etc.).
FECT.Settings.HideDefeatedHint: Hides combatants marked as defeated (dead) from the tracker.

FESP.Sheet.FaceThumbDropHint: Dragging an actor here sets its portrait/token image as the face image.
FESP.Sheet.DblclickCycleHint: Double-clicking this panel on the canvas advances to the next face. When off, faces can only be changed via the right-click menu. Per-panel setting that applies to all users.
FESP.Sheet.NoFacesHint: A face is one image this panel can show. Add a face and assign an image to place it on a scene.
FESP.Sheet.FaceSizeHint: Selecting a new image automatically sets the size to the original image's pixel size. Each face can be adjusted separately afterward.
FESP.Sheet.LockedHint: When on, this panel cannot be moved by dragging on the canvas. Face switching and overlay value editing still work. The right-click menu's 'Pin position' locks only that one placement, while this setting applies to every placement of this panel.
FESP.Sheet.OverlayLinkHint: Drag & drop an actor or paste a UUID. The attribute path is read from that actor's data.

FE.SettingsData.conflictGuardMode.yield: Yield only — leaves the other module alone and disables this module's feature
FE.SettingsData.conflictGuardMode.off: Off — disables detection and warnings too
FE.SettingsData.enableFonts.name: Apply custom fonts (CookieRun/Geurimilgi)
FE.SettingsData.enableFonts.hint: Enables this module's ui-font.css. The CookieRun + Geurimilgi fonts and related options (chat font selection, etc.) will work.
FE.SettingsData.hideChatPortraits.name: Hide default chat portraits (built-in/default)
FE.SettingsData.hideChatPortraits.hint: Hides the default avatar/portrait in chat card headers (and some icons added by the chat-portrait module). Portraits inserted by this module (.fe-chat-portrait-wrap) are controlled by a separate option.
FE.SettingsData.stripChatTextures.name: Strip chat card textures
FE.SettingsData.stripChatTextures.hint: Removes the parchment/texture background image from chat cards. The flat off-white overlay is selected separately under 'Paper tone overlay'.
FE.SettingsData.ceAnimatedTileEnabled.hi: Actually plays animated gif/webp/apng images assigned to tiles. Foundry's default behavior shows only the first frame as a still image.
FE.SettingsData.cePruneEnabled.name: Chat DOM pruning (performance optimization)
FE.SettingsData.cePruneEnabled.hint: When many messages accumulate, old messages are removed from the DOM to improve performance. Scrolling up loads them again. (Reload required after changing)
FE.SettingsData.cePruneMaxMessages.name: Chat DOM pruning: Max messages kept
FE.SettingsData.cePruneMaxMessages.hint: The maximum number of messages kept in the DOM at once. Older messages beyond this are removed. Each scroll loads half of this value. (Applies immediately)
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeEnabled.name: Chat merge (visually group consecutive messages)
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeEnabled.hint: Groups consecutive messages from the same speaker/user so they look like one (no document edits).
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeOnlyText.name: Chat merge: Text messages only
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeOnlyText.hint: Plain text with inline rolls mixed in can be merged. Dedicated dice result card merging can be enabled with the option below; midi/dnd5e chat cards are not merged by default.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeIncludeRollMessag: Chat merge: Include dice result messages

When off, .dice-roll / .dice-result / ChatMessage.rolls messages are excluded from merging. When on, consecutive dice result messages from the same speaker can also be merged. Rolls inside cards are governed by the 'Include chat cards' option instead of this one.
When off, chat cards from dnd5e / midi-qol / monks-tokenbar / dx3rd etc. are excluded from merging. When on (default), consecutive cards from the same speaker are grouped into one block. Cards carry their own header (item name, icon), so no information is lost when the follow message's speaker header is hidden. Even if a card contains rolls, only this option applies — not 'Include dice result messages'.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeDivider.name: Chat merge: Show group divider
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeDivider.hint: Shows a thin divider when a new group from a different speaker begins.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeGroupSpacing.name: Chat merge: Spacing between groups (px)
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeGroupSpacing.hint: Extra spacing (px) between different speakers' groups. Applied equally around messages excluded from merging, such as dnd5e chat cards.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeMode.name: Chat merge mode
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeMode.hint: Standard merges message boxes all the way to their borders; Simple only hides headers on follow-up messages from the same speaker.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeFollowHeaderStyle: Sets how headers appear on consecutive messages (from the second onward) from the same speaker.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeSpeakerBasis.name: Chat merge: Speaker grouping basis
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeSpeakerBasis.hint: Decides how 'same speaker' is judged when grouping consecutive messages. / Token (default): by token placed on the scene — if the GM runs the same actor through different tokens, they form separate groups. / Actor: by actor — the same actor merges even across different tokens. / Player (author): by posting user — messages from the same player merge regardless of speaker.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeSpeakerBasis.choi: Token (default) — merges only when token+actor+scene all match
Actor — merges if same actor (ignores token)
FE.SettingsData.ceExportEnabled.name: Chat log PDF export button
FE.SettingsData.ceExportEnabled.hint: Adds a PDF (print) button next to the chat input.
FE.SettingsData.ceExportAutoPrint.name: PDF button: Auto-open print dialog
FE.SettingsData.ceExportAutoPrint.hint: When on, clicking the PDF button opens the archive window and automatically opens the print dialog. When off, only the archive opens.
FE.SettingsData.ceExportOptimize.name: Export optimization (size/freeze prevention)
FE.SettingsData.ceExportOptimize.hint: Forcibly removes parchment/texture images and shadows during archive/print, greatly reducing PDF size and memory usage (recommended).
FE.SettingsData.ceExportEmbedFonts.name: HTML save: Embed custom fonts
FE.SettingsData.ceExportEmbedFonts.hint: When saving as HTML, embeds the CookieRun font into the file so the font is preserved even when opened standalone later.
FE.SettingsData.ceExportEmbedImages.name: HTML save: Embed images
FE.SettingsData.ceExportEmbedImages.hint: When saving as HTML, embeds chat log images (portraits, icons, etc.) into the file. Repeated images are automatically deduplicated to save space.
Excludes whispers from archive/save/print. Since the GM can see all whispers, logs saved by the GM will include private conversations unless this is enabled.
FE.SettingsData.ceExportPrintImageMode.h: In Chrome/Electron printing (PDF), many images can spike memory and freeze. For PDF stability, avatars/images can be hidden or downscaled.
FE.SettingsData.ceExportDesktopExternalM: [Legacy compatibility] FVTT desktop open in external browser
No longer used. The FVTT desktop app only saves HTML archives — open the saved file in a browser to save it as PDF.
FE.SettingsData.ceActorNameSize.name: Chat: Actor name size (px)
FE.SettingsData.ceActorNameSize.hint: Font size of the actor (character) name in chat message headers.
FE.SettingsData.cePlayerNameSize.name: Chat: Player name size (px)
FE.SettingsData.cePlayerNameSize.hint: Font size of the player name (subtitle) in chat message headers.
FE.SettingsData.ceMessageTextSize.name: Chat: Message text size (px)
FE.SettingsData.ceMessageTextSize.hint: Font size of normal chat text (message content).
FE.SettingsData.ceChatCardTextSize.name: Chat: Spell/item/feature description text size (px)
FE.SettingsData.ceChatCardTextSize.hint: Default font size for the description area of dnd5e chat cards (spells/items/features).
FE.SettingsData.ceChatMessageSpacing.hin: Default spacing (flex gap) between all chat message cards. Applied regardless of merging. (Managed via the --fe-chat-message-spacing variable to prevent v14 sidebar side effects)
FE.SettingsData.ceHeaderContentGap.name: Chat: Header-content gap (px)
FE.SettingsData.ceHeaderContentGap.hint: Vertical gap between the message header (actor name, portrait) and the message content.
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeInnerGap.name: Chat merge: Inner gap between merged messages (px)
FE.SettingsData.ceMergeInnerGap.hint: Vertical gap (px) between consecutive merged messages from the same speaker. Simple mode: effective gap between boxes = this value. Standard mode: top+bottom padding (×2) becomes the effective gap between contents.
FE.SettingsData.ceChatFontChoice.name: Chat/UI font selection
FE.SettingsData.ceChatFontChoice.hint: Selects the base font for chat messages, headers, and UI. 'CookieRun + Geurimilgi' also uses Geurimilgi for the UI/sheet base font. Has no effect when 'Apply custom fonts' is off.
FE.SettingsData.ceCanvasTextFont.name: Token nameplate & cursor font
FE.SettingsData.ceCanvasTextFont.hint: Also applies the font chosen above to text drawn on the scene (token nameplates, other users' cursor names, measurement/template labels, etc.). This text is drawn directly on the canvas rather than via CSS, so it needs separate handling. 'Apply custom fonts' must be on.
FE.SettingsData.ceCanvasDrawingFont.name: Canvas font (drawings & map notes)
FE.SettingsData.ceCanvasDrawingFont.hint: Registers the module fonts in Foundry's font list so they can be picked directly in the font selector of drawings, map notes, and the journal editor. When on, drawings/notes whose font is 'Default' display in the font chosen above; when off they return to Foundry's default font (list registration is kept). 'Apply custom fonts' must be on.
FE.SettingsData.ceUiUseGeurimilgi.name: (internal) UI/sheet Geurimilgi sync
FE.SettingsData.ceUiUseGeurimilgi.hint: Internal value for legacy compatibility. Currently synced automatically from the 'CookieRun + Geurimilgi' preset in 'Chat/UI font selection'.
FE.SettingsData.ceUiUseUserFont.name: Use user (local) font
FE.SettingsData.ceUiUseUserFont.hint: When on, applies the 'user font' chosen below (a font installed on your computer or in the module's font folder) across chat and the whole UI, instead of this module's custom fonts (CookieRun/Geurimilgi). 'Apply custom fonts' must be on. (Personal setting — not subject to GM global enforcement)
FE.SettingsData.ceUserFontFamily.name: User font family
FE.SettingsData.ceUserFontFamily.hint: The family name of the font to apply (e.g. Malgun Gothic). Choose from the installed font list or module fonts in the settings menu, or type it directly.
FE.SettingsData.ceUiDx3rdPixelTheme.name: Retro theme (pixel high-contrast)
FE.SettingsData.ceUiDx3rdPixelTheme.hint: Transforms all UI elements to square corners (border-radius 0), antialiasing off, and instant transitions. Usable on any system; DX3rd/D&D 5e-specific layout adjustments apply only on those systems. Recommended with NeoDGM font mode.
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdCardBorderAlpha.h: Alpha value of the player-color border on chat cards in the pixel theme. 0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque.
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdPixelAccent.name: [DX3rd] Pixel theme accent color
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdPixelAccent.hint: Accent color applied to borders, text, and the checkerboard pattern in the pixel theme. Change it via the color swatch in chat controls.
FE.SettingsData.ceUseUserColorBg.name: Chat message background: Apply user color (Chat Portrait style)
FE.SettingsData.ceUseUserColorBg.hint: Tints each message background with the speaker's (actor owner/author) user color.
FE.SettingsData.ceUserColorBgBase.name: Chat message background: Chat card underlay (opaque)
FE.SettingsData.ceUserColorBgBase.hint: Lays an opaque background (white/dark gray/custom) under chat cards for readability. Works independently of the user color tint, so it applies even when the tint is off.
FE.SettingsData.ceUserColorBgCustom.name: Chat message background: Custom underlay color
FE.SettingsData.ceUserColorBgCustom.hint: The color used when the underlay is set to 'Custom color'.
FE.SettingsData.ceUserColorAlpha.name: Chat message background: User color tint amount
FE.SettingsData.ceUserColorAlpha.hint: How strongly the user color tints the background (0.05–0.8). Higher = stronger.
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgColor.name: Apply GM user color tint to system messages too
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgColor.hint: Applies the GM's user color and tint amount to system messages that have no speaker (character). Narrator chat (/narrate, /describe, /note) is excluded.
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgAlpha.name: System message tint amount
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgAlpha.hint: How strongly the GM user color tints system messages (0.05–0.8). Separate from normal messages.
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgBgEnabled.nam: Apply underlay color to system messages
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgBgEnabled.hin: Applies the chosen opaque underlay color to speaker-less system messages.
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgBgBase.name: System message underlay
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgBgBase.hint: Sets the opaque underlay color for speaker-less system/GM messages.
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgBgColor.name: System message underlay: Custom color
FE.SettingsData.ceSystemMsgBgColor.hint: The underlay color used when 'Custom color' is selected above.
FE.SettingsData.ceForceNormalMsgColor.na: Force normal message card/text colors (system defaults)
FE.SettingsData.ceForceNormalMsgColor.hi: When on, forces normal chat message card background and text colors (excluding special messages and user colors) to system/theme defaults. Use it to restore readability when a module that repaints the whole chat (e.g. Carolingian UI) overwrites normal messages. When off, that module's chat style is kept.
FE.SettingsData.ceChatGroupOutline.name: Chat: Merge group outline
FE.SettingsData.ceChatGroupOutline.hint: Wraps merged message groups (or single messages) in an outline (user color) so they look like boxes. When off, only the tinted background is used.
FE.SettingsData.ceMsgBorderUserColor.nam: Chat: Show user color on message borders
FE.SettingsData.ceMsgBorderUserColor.hin: Shows the sender user color that core Foundry automatically applies to speaker-less (OOC) message borders. When off, borders return to the default color (retro accent in the retro theme). 'Merge group outline' takes priority if enabled.
FE.SettingsData.ceAccentTextOverride.hin: Unifies the retro theme's accent color (text, borders, checkerboard) to a tone based on the pixel theme accent swatch. When off, all accents return to default whites (white/gray) and the accent swatch button in chat controls is hidden.
FE.SettingsData.cePaperOverlayEnabled.hi: Adds a flat off-white overlay to reduce saturation when textures are stripped. A separate opt-in feature; off by default.
FE.SettingsData.ceMessageBgSaturation.hi: Alpha value of the off-white layer applied when the paper tone overlay is on. Higher values are brighter and less saturated.
FE.SettingsData.ceMarkdownEnabled.name: Chat input Markdown support
FE.SettingsData.ceMarkdownEnabled.hint: Processes chat input text as Markdown (images/links/headings/bold/italic/strikethrough/quotes).
FE.SettingsData.ceEditEnabled.name: Chat edit dialog
FE.SettingsData.ceEditEnabled.hint: Uses a Markdown-based edit dialog when the message edit button is clicked.
FE.SettingsData.ceGmPriorityEnabled.name: GM settings global enforcement
FE.SettingsData.ceGmPriorityEnabled.hint: When on, all of the GM's module settings are forced onto every player except the 3 exclusions below.
FE.SettingsData.ceCorePriorityEnabled.hi: When on, Foundry's own 'Configure Settings' options are forced to the GM's values for all players.
FE.SettingsData.ceGmSpeakAsSelf.name: GM: Chat as self when a PC token is selected
FE.SettingsData.ceGmSpeakAsSelf.hint: When on, messages sent by the GM while a player-owned character token is selected display as the GM, not that character.
FE.SettingsData.chatImagesEnabled.name: Enable chat image upload/embed
FE.SettingsData.chatImagesEnabled.hint: Enables the chat image features (upload button, paste/drag-and-drop, !ci|path! embeds) independently of Foundry file permissions.
FE.SettingsData.chatImagesShowButton.hin: Shows an image upload button in the controls at the right of the chat input. Paste/drag-and-drop still works when off.
FE.SettingsData.chatImagesUploadLocation: The data folder path where images pasted/dropped into chat or picked via the upload button are stored. Images from players without file permission are proxy-uploaded to this path by an online GM.
FE.SettingsData.chatImagesMaxUploadMB.hi: Maximum size of a single image uploadable to chat. Applies to direct upload, GM proxy upload, and in-message embedding (data URL) alike. Proxy uploads land on the GM's memory and in-message embeds on the database plus every connected client's traffic — don't raise this carelessly.
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitEnabled.name: Enable chat portraits
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitEnabled.hint: Inserts an actor (or token) image into chat message cards. (If the chat-portrait module is active, portraits may be duplicated; only a console warning is shown.)
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitHideWrap.hin: Hides the portrait (image) this module inserts into chat card headers. Separate from the existing 'Hide default chat portraits (built-in/default)' option.
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitUseTokenImag: Use token image for chat portraits
When on, uses the token image instead of the actor portrait.
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitSize.name: Chat portrait size (px)
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitSize.hint: The width/height of the portrait image (px).
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitCardIconSize: Forcibly resizes card header images to prevent oversized icons/portraits inside midi-qol/dnd5e chat cards. Set to 0 to disable.
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitShape.name: Chat portrait shape
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitShape.hint: Sets the portrait shape/cropping method. 'None' adjusts size only, without border/cropping.
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitBorderMode.h: Sets the border style of portrait images. 'Theme/default' keeps other theme/module styles as-is.
Applies when border mode is 'Player color' or 'Custom'.
Used when border mode is 'Custom'. e.g. #000000
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitNameAlign.hi: Displays the actor name/player name in the header center- or left-aligned.
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitShowIC.name: Show portrait: IC
FE.SettingsData.chatPortraitShowOOC.name: Show portrait: OOC
FE.SettingsData.ceConflictGuardMode.name: Conflicting module guard behavior
FE.SettingsData.ceConflictGuardMode.hint: Behavior when another module overlapping female_edition's built-in features is detected. Default is 'Auto': abandoned duplicate modules are neutralized at runtime, while maintained modules take over our feature. Choose 'Warn only' to run both modules despite duplication. Changing this requires a reload.
FE.SettingsData.ceConflictGuardMode.choi: Yield only — leaves the other module alone and disables our feature
Warn only — disables nothing, just notifies
Off — disables detection and warnings too
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdRuiEnabled.name: Show status UI
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdRuiEnabled.hint: Shows HP/resource cards (status UI) for pinned actors on screen. When off, the whole status UI and the chat toggle button are disabled.
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdRuiVisible.name: Status UI display (visibility)
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdRuiVisible.hint: Shows status UI cards on screen. When off, pins are kept but the cards are hidden. (Replaces the old chat toggle button)
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdRuiYieldToTracker: Yield to combat tracker during combat
During combat, if the combat tracker is showing HP (HP bars or dynamic combat portraits), the status UI is disabled only for that time. The status UI returns when combat ends.
Width of the portrait image area. Default 100.
FE.SettingsData.ceDx3rdRuiPanelWidth.hin: Width of the panel showing the HP/encroachment-rate bars. Default 128.
FE.SettingsData.ceCoreUiFilepickerEnhanc: Core UI: File picker preview & enhancements
Enables file picker preview/sorting and external image paste/drop upload.
FE.SettingsData.ceCoreUiFilepickerUpload: File picker external image upload path
The data folder path that stores only images pasted or dropped into the file picker.
FE.SettingsData.ihPermission.name: Image Hover: Minimum permission to view art
FE.SettingsData.ihPermission.hint: Minimum Actor permission required to view character art.
FE.SettingsData.ihArtType.name: Image Hover: Art type to display
FE.SettingsData.ihArtType.hint: The kind of art shown on hover.
FE.SettingsData.ihEnabled.name: Image Hover: Enable/disable
FE.SettingsData.ihEnabled.hint: When disabled, Image Hover is turned off on this client.
FE.SettingsData.ihPosition.name: Image Hover: Image position
FE.SettingsData.ihPosition.hint: Where the image appears on screen. When GM settings enforcement is on, all clients use the GM's value.
FE.SettingsData.ihSize.name: Image Hover: Image size (1/N of screen width)
FE.SettingsData.ihSize.hint: Smaller values = larger image. Unified to the GM's value when GM settings enforcement is on.
FE.SettingsData.ihSizeWide.name: Image Hover: Wide image size (1/N of screen height)
FE.SettingsData.ihSizeWide.hint: Wide images (width:height ≥ 1.2) are sized against the vertical axis. Smaller = larger; 1.0 fills the screen height. Unified to the GM's value when GM settings enforcement is on.

FE.SettingsData.ihMaxUpscale.hint: Maximum enlargement limit relative to original resolution. Small sources aren't scaled beyond this factor, preventing blur. 0 = no limit (always shown at the configured size). Unified to the GM's value when GM settings enforcement is on.
FE.SettingsData.ihDelay.name: Image Hover: Display delay (ms)
FE.SettingsData.ihDelay.hint: Wait time (milliseconds) after pressing the show-art key until the image appears. Unified to the GM's value when GM settings enforcement is on.
FE.SettingsData.narratorEnabled.name: Enable narrator features
FE.SettingsData.narratorEnabled.hint: Enables the /narrate, /describe, /note, /as commands and the cinematic narration overlay in the sidebar chat. (A separate channel from stage chat)
FE.SettingsData.narratorDurationMult.hin: Multiplies how long the /narrate overlay stays on screen by this value.
FE.SettingsData.narratorAllowCopy.name: Narrator: Show copy button
FE.SettingsData.narratorPermNarrate.name: Narrator: /narrate minimum role
FE.SettingsData.narratorPermAs.name: Narrator: /as minimum role

FE.SettingsData.stageExcludeSystemMessag: System messages such as item/attack cards, initiative, and messages generated by other modules are not sent to the stage as speech — they keep their original speaker.
FE.SettingsData.stageNameUserColor.name: Stage chat: Use speaker color for names
FE.SettingsData.stageNameUserColor.hint: In the non-retro theme, uses the speaker's user color for actor names. When off, uses the speech box's default text color.
FE.SettingsData.stageRecallIncludeNonAct: Stage chat: Include non-actor messages in recall

FE.SettingsData.ceTokenGlowHover.name: Glow on hover too

FE.SettingsData.ceTokenGlowSightline.hin: Draws a sightline from the selected token to its target. Also visible to other players (in owner color), with distance shown at the line's end.
FE.SettingsData.ceTokenSyncName.name: Sync actor name to prototype token name
FE.SettingsData.ceTokenSyncName.hint: Renaming an actor also renames its prototype token. To also rename tokens already placed on scenes, enable the separate option below.
FE.SettingsData.ceTokenSyncPlacedName.na: Sync actor name to placed token names
FE.SettingsData.ceTokenSyncPlacedName.hi: Renaming an actor also renames that actor's tokens placed on every scene. While on, custom names set on individual tokens will be overwritten by the actor name at the next actor rename.
FE.SettingsData.ceCoreUiTokenPreview.hin: Shows a live preview on the prototype token's Appearance tab.
FE.SettingsData.ceTokenConfigTwoColumn.n: Prototype token config: Two-column layout on other tabs
FE.SettingsData.ceTokenConfigTwoColumn.h: In the token config window widened for the visual preview, non-Appearance tabs are also laid out in two columns. When off, tabs use Foundry's default single column.
FE.SettingsData.ceTypingEnabled.name: Show typing indicator ('… is typing')
FE.SettingsData.ceTypingEnabled.hint: Shown above the input box when another user is typing. Automatically disabled if CautiousGamemastersPack (CGMP)'s typing notification is active, yielding to CGMP.
FE.SettingsData.ceTypingShowToPlayers.na: Typing indicator: Show to players too

FE.SettingsData.condMatingName.hint: Display name for the 'Mating' condition when custom condition injection is enabled. Empty shows '00'.

FE.SettingsMenu.ceCoreUiFilepickerUpload: The data folder that stores only images pasted or dropped into the file picker. Default is uploaded-filepicker-images, kept separate from the chat image folder.
FE.SettingsMenu.Dnd5eItemSheet.Title: dnd5e item sheet
dnd5e 6.0 changed item rarity to a tag input that can hold multiple values. Selecting from the dropdown adds a tag each time, and removing one also requires clicking the tag. When this option is on, it displays as a single-choice dropdown like before. Saving still uses the new format (system.rarities), so data compatibility is unaffected. On dnd5e 5.x and below it was already a dropdown, so this has no effect.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceDnd5eItemSheetFlat.Hin: Removes the parchment/denim texture images on the item sheet background and the banner image over the header. The background color stays at the theme's value, so it reads the same in light and dark themes.
Prevents scene config tab names from wrapping to two lines and widens the window's default width so tabs fit on one line. Sheet windows are reused once opened, so changes apply after a reload.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceExportPrintImageMode.H: FVTT desktop app (Electron): In-app PDF printing uses OS print features like Microsoft Print to PDF and can be slow or fail to save. Therefore the desktop app only saves HTML archives instead of PDF. Open the saved HTML file in Chrome/Edge and use Print → Save as PDF. When connected via a regular web browser, the normal PDF print feature works as before.
FE.SettingsMenu.chatImagesEnabled.Hint: Enables the upload button, paste, drag-and-drop, and !ci|path! embed features independently of Foundry file permissions. Without direct upload permission, an online GM proxy-uploads.
FE.SettingsMenu.ihMaxUpscale.Hint: Maximum enlargement limit relative to original resolution. Small sources aren't scaled beyond this factor, preventing blur. 0 = no limit (always shown at the configured size).
FE.SettingsMenu.music.Hint: Players upload their audio files to one shared playlist and everyone plays/stops together. Uploads are done directly by players with the FILES_UPLOAD permission, or handled by the GM when online. Files with the same name+size reuse the existing file without duplication. Open the window via the 🎵 button in the playlist sidebar header. All are GM-only world settings.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMusicPlaylistName.Hint: Used only when the playlist is first created (does not rename existing ones). Shared with all players at OWNER permission.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMusicUploadRoot.Hint: To save under ~data/assets/uploadedmusic, enter assets/uploadedmusic. Leading Data\ or ~data/ is automatically stripped.
FE.SettingsMenu.canvas.Hint: When a token is selected or hovered on the canvas, shows a glow following the token image's opaque silhouette instead of the grid square border. The glow color keeps the original selection border's hue (selected=green, disposition colors, etc.).
FE.SettingsMenu.ceTokenGlowTarget.Hint: Also applies the glow to the grid-corner arrow marker on tokens targeted (T).
FE.SettingsMenu.canvas.Hint2: Foundry draws animated gif/webp/apng assigned to tiles only as first-frame stills (only webm/mp4 actually play). When on, frames are decoded manually so they actually play.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceConflictGuardMode.Hint: Auto: abandoned duplicate modules are neutralized for this session only, while maintained modules take over this module's corresponding feature. Yield only: never touches the other module — only disables this module's feature. Warn only: disables nothing and just notifies, so both modules keep running together (duplicate display accepted). Off: disables detection and warnings entirely.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCorePriorityEnabled.Hi: Why it's needed: Foundry client settings are stored separately per browser address (origin). Even on the same server, values differ between connecting via localhost:30000 and via an external address, so someone joining through an external address may see lighting animations frozen. This feature aligns those differences to the GM's values.
FE.SettingsMenu.General.Text: Please remove one of the two conflicting modules from the world (you'll spare me, right??).
FE.SettingsMenu.cePruneEnabled.Text: Removes old messages from the DOM to improve performance. Scrolling up reloads them. (Reload required after changing)
FE.SettingsMenu.cePruneMaxMessages.Text2: Older messages beyond this count are removed. Each scroll loads half of this value. (Applies immediately, default: 60)
FE.SettingsMenu.ceTypingEnabled.Text: Shown above the input box when another user is typing. Automatically disabled and yields to CGMP when CautiousGamemastersPack (CGMP) is active.
FE.SettingsMenu.enableFonts.Text2: Enables this module's custom fonts (CookieRun/Geurimilgi) and related options. Always stays personal — not subject to GM settings enforcement.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUiUseUserFont.Text: Applies a font installed on your computer or in the module's font folder across chat and the whole UI (full replacement, like NeoDGM). When on, 'User font selection' is used instead of 'Chat font selection' (module fonts) below. Always stays personal — not subject to GM settings enforcement.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceChatFontChoice.Text2: 'CookieRun + Geurimilgi' mixes CookieRun for large/emphasized text and Geurimilgi for small text plus the UI/sheet base font. Other options unify chat, UI, and sheets into that font. ('Apply custom fonts' must be on)
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUserFontFamily.Text5: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog — ABCabc XYZ 0123
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUserFontFamily.Text6: Pick from the list or type a font family name directly (the value in the field below is what actually applies). 'Load system fonts' fills in the installed font list — it may require a one-time browser permission.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUserFontFamily.Text7: This environment doesn't support automatic font listing — only manual input or fonts in the module folder can be used.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCanvasTextFont.Text: Also applies the font chosen above to text drawn on the scene (token nameplates, other users' cursor names, measurement/template labels, etc.). This text is drawn directly on the canvas rather than via CSS, so it needs separate handling.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCanvasDrawingFont.Text: Registers the module fonts in Foundry's font list so they can be picked directly in the font selector of drawings, map notes, and the journal editor. When on, drawings/notes whose font is 'Default' display in the font chosen above; when off they return to Foundry's default font (list registration is kept).
Collapses layer/tool rows so only the currently selected cell is visible. Clicking the cell expands it; picking an item collapses it again. Also collapses on outside click/Esc. Always stays personal — not subject to GM settings enforcement.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceAttrPathHelper.Text2: Hovering over a value shown on a sheet or in chat displays its system attribute name (e.g. system.attributes.init.value) as a tooltip. If an existing tooltip is present, it's appended on the line below; otherwise it shows as its own tooltip. The value itself isn't shown. A shared inspection tool for dnd5e and dx3rd. Unified to the GM's value when GM settings enforcement is on.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCoreUiTokenPreview.Tex: Shows a live preview of the prototype token's grid/anchor and adjustment sliders on the Appearance tab. Applies to newly opened token config windows.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCoreUiFilepickerEnhanc: Enables file picker preview, name/date/size sorting, and auto-selection after image paste/drop upload. Applies to newly opened file pickers.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCoreUiFilepickerUpload: File picker external image upload path (GM only)
Scene config tabs on one line
FE.SettingsMenu.ceTokenConfigTwoColumn.T: Token config: Two-column layout on other tabs
In the prototype token config window widened for the visual preview, non-Appearance tabs are also laid out in two columns. When off, tabs use Foundry's default single column.
FE.SettingsMenu.stripChatTextures.Text: Removes the parchment/texture background image from chat cards. The flat off-white overlay is selected separately below.
FE.SettingsMenu.cePaperOverlayEnabled.Te: Adds a flat off-white overlay to reduce saturation when textures are stripped. Off by default.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMessageBgSaturation.Te: Only used when the overlay above is on. Higher values are brighter and less saturated.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUseUserColorBg.Text: Chat message background: Apply user color
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUserColorBgBase.Text2: Lays an opaque background (white/dark gray/custom) under chat cards for readability. Works independently of the 'Apply user color' tint above, so it applies even when the tint is off.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceUserColorBgCustom.Text: The underlay color used when 'Custom color' is selected above.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceSystemMsgBgEnabled.Tex: Applies an opaque underlay color to speaker-less system messages.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceSystemMsgBgBase.Text2: The underlay used when the option directly above is on. Uses the same three tones as the chat card underlay.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceSystemMsgBgColor.Text: Used only when 'Custom color' is selected directly above.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceForceNormalMsgColor.Te: Forces normal message (excluding special messages and user colors) card background and text colors to system/theme defaults. Restores readability when a module that repaints the whole chat (e.g. Carolingian UI) overwrites normal messages.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMsgBorderUserColor.Tex: Shows the sender user color that core Foundry automatically applies to speaker-less (OOC) message borders. When off, borders return to the default color (retro accent in the retro theme). 'Merge group outline' above takes priority if enabled.
FE.SettingsMenu.hideChatPortraits.Text: Hides the default avatar/portrait in chat card headers. (Portraits inserted by this module are a separate option)
FE.SettingsMenu.ceChatMessageSpacing.Tex: Default spacing (flex gap) between all chat message cards. Applied regardless of merging.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceHeaderContentGap.Text: Vertical gap between the actor name/portrait header and the message content.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMergeIncludeRollMessag: When off, dedicated dice result cards are excluded from merging.
When on, consecutive chat cards from the same speaker are grouped under the first card.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMergeGroupSpacing.Text: Spacing (px) between different speakers' groups. Applied equally around non-merged messages like chat cards (dnd5e items/spells, etc.).
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMergeInnerGap.Text: Vertical gap between consecutive merged messages from the same speaker. In standard mode the top+bottom total (×2) becomes the effective gap.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceMergeSpeakerBasis.Text: Token: scene+token+actor all match / Actor: actor id matches / Player: merges if same user
FE.SettingsMenu.archive.Text2: Export-related settings always stay personal and are not subject to GM settings enforcement.

FE.SettingsMenu.ceExportOptimize.Text: Forcibly removes some effects like textures and shadows to reduce PDF size and memory usage.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceExportEmbedImages.Text: Repeated images are automatically deduplicated to save space.

FE.SettingsMenu.ceExportPrintImageMode.T: Applies only to PDF/printing in web browsers. The FVTT desktop app (Electron) uses HTML archive saving, so it doesn't apply there.
FE.SettingsMenu.chatPortraitHideWrap.Tex: Hides the portrait wrapper itself inserted into chat cards.
FE.SettingsMenu.chatPortraitUseTokenImag: Use token image instead of portrait
FE.SettingsMenu.chatPortraitCardIconSize: Forcibly adjusts icon size inside midi-qol/dnd5e chat cards. 0 disables it.
Used when border mode is 'Custom'. e.g. #ff0000
FE.SettingsMenu.injectCustomConditions.T: Registers custom conditions into dnd5e. World reload required after changing.

FE.SettingsMenu.ceUiDx3rdPixelTheme.Text: Converts all UI elements to square corners (border-radius 0), antialiasing off, and instant transitions. Works on any system. Recommended with the NeoDGM font mode.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceDx3rdRuiEnabled.Text: Shows HP/resource cards for pinned actors on screen. When off, the whole Status UI is disabled. (Shared by dx3rd and dnd5e)
FE.SettingsMenu.ceDx3rdRuiVisible.Text2: Whether to show status cards on screen. When off, pins are kept and only the cards are hidden. On by default. (Replaces the status toggle button in earlier chats)
FE.SettingsMenu.ceDx3rdRuiYieldToTracker: Yield to combat tracker during combat

While the combat tracker is showing HP during combat, the Status UI is temporarily disabled, and restored when combat ends. Both features show the same numbers — during combat the tracker shows them for every combatant at once, making the status cards redundant. 'Showing' requires combat on screen, the tracker enabled (and not yielded to Carousel Combat Tracker), and either 'HP bar display' or 'Dynamic battle portraits' on. On by default.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceDx3rdCardBorderAlpha.T: Alpha of the player-color chat card border in the pixel theme. 0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully opaque.
FE.SettingsMenu.chatImagesShowButton.Tex: Shows an upload button in the chat input controls. Paste/drag still work when off.
FE.SettingsMenu.chatImagesMaxUploadMB.Te: Maximum size per image (default 20MB). Applies to all three paths: direct upload, GM proxy upload, and in-message embedding. Raising it isn't recommended — proxy upload loads it into GM client memory, and in-message embedding lands directly on the database and every connected client's traffic.
FE.SettingsMenu.ihEnabled.Text: Shows character art when hovering a token on this client.
FE.SettingsMenu.ihSize.Text2: Smaller values make the image larger.
FE.SettingsMenu.ihSizeWide.Text: Wide image size — 1/N of screen height

FE.SettingsMenu.narratorEnabled.Text: The /narrate · /describe · /note · /as commands in sidebar chat and the cinematic overlay.
FE.SettingsMenu.stageExcludeSystemMessag: Item/attack cards, initiative, and system messages created by other modules aren't spoken on stage — they keep their original speaker.
FE.SettingsMenu.stageRecallIncludeNonAct: Include non-actor messages in previous messages (GM)

FE.SettingsMenu.stageNameUserColor.Text2: Tints actor names with the user's color. When off, the speech box default text color is used.

FE.SettingsMenu.ceScreenPanelGridSnap.Te: Aligns the panel to the scene grid while dragging (gridless scenes use the default grid size). Can also be toggled from the right-click menu. Unified to the GM's value when GM settings enforcement is on.

FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerEnabled.T: Shows combatant portraits in a row at the top of the screen during combat, with GM turn/round controls in the center. Automatically disabled and yields to 「Carousel Combat Tracker」 when that is active. Changing requires a restart.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerHideDefea: When off, defeated combatants stay visible in grayscale. When on, they're fully removed from the tracker.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerPortraitI: Chooses between actor portrait or token image.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerShowDispo: Colors the border by token disposition — friendly/neutral/hostile, etc. The current-turn combatant's accent border takes priority.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerDynamicPo: Only for tall/extra-tall portraits. Shows the name, HP dial (current HP)/max HP, condition and AE icons, replacing the plain actor name.
'Bottom' inserts the panel below the portrait. Overlay covers part of the portrait's lower area.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerDbpHpStyl: 'Dial' spins on every HP change before settling on the final value. 'Bar' works like the Status UI. The 'default HP bar' under the portrait isn't drawn — it would duplicate.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceCombatTrackerHiddenPar: Partial reveal when HP is hidden
Determines whether actors with hidden HP still allow 'approximate info'. Reveals only the highest digit.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceTokenGlowHover.Text: When off, the glow only shows on actually selected (controlled) tokens.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceTokenGlowSightline.Tex: Draws a sightline from the selected (controlled) token to the targeted token with a faint glow.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceAnimatedTileEnabled.Te: Has no effect on ordinary static images (checked once, never re-scanned). Since all frames are loaded into memory for playback, placing many files with lots of high-resolution frames increases memory usage.
FE.SettingsMenu.ceConflictGuardMode.Text: Behavior when another module overlapping this module's built-in features (narrator, stage, image hover, chat cleanup, etc.) is detected.
On values other than 'Auto', locks placed on this module's settings by 「Force Client Settings」 are also not released. Reload required after changing.
